description: DiligenceOps: submit one contract excerpt. The signed brief states the parties with their roles, the term with its effective and end dates and length, renewal with its kind, period and notice, termination with its grounds, notice and cure periods and fees, and payment with its amounts, due terms, frequency and late charges, each quoted, and lists what the excerpt does not state. POST /api/contract-brief. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-terms-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the contract, recorded in the brief.

text.description: One contract excerpt, up to 256 KB.
